complete_ik_profile.note: Scopes nest; GPU intervals overlap CPU work and may include command gaps. Neither list is additive. CPU samples exclude threads absent at an endpoint. Frame intervals are the actual whole-application throughput measurement.

same_frame_completion.note: max(CPU end, calibrated GPU end) minus CPU frame start. Includes queueing and diagnostics; excludes compositor/scanout. Latency is not inverted to report FPS.
